evals.prompt: Make an 8-direction pixel sprite of the droid in ./droid.png. Don't spend anything yet, just show me what it would cost.
evals.expected_output: Runs turnaround.py --mode pixel with --ref droid.png (no --yes), reports the Retro Diffusion rotate8 cost check ($0.25, 80x80, up to 5 refs) and explains that --yes would produce turnaround.png plus an atlas v2 manifest with directions S,SE,E,NE,N,NW,W,SW.
expectations: Uses scripts/turnaround.py --mode pixel (or retro_diffusion.py rotate8) rather than a general image model
States the price from the dry run
Mentions the atlas v2 manifest and the 8-direction order

evals.prompt: Turn this character (hero.png) into a looping walk-cycle sprite sheet for Phaser. Preview the plan first.
evals.expected_output: Runs video_to_spritesheet.py --provider genmedia with --start-frame hero.png --end-frame hero.png on a first+last-frame model (Wan 3 default) with a chroma prompt, without --yes; explains the pipeline: chroma key once, align_frames feet-line alignment with dedup and loop check, stitch --atlas v2 --state walk:12:loop --aseprite-json.
expectations: Uses a first+last-frame video model with the same image as start and end frame
Prompts for a flat #00FF00 background and keys with chroma_key, not rembg per frame
Runs or describes align_frames.py and cites feet-line variance under 1 px

evals.prompt: Upscale sprite.png (an indexed 8-bit PNG) 4x for an HD build without introducing any new colours.
evals.expected_output: Runs pixel_scale.py --mode scale4x (or --mode nearest --factor 4 if exactness is required) and reports that the output is mode P with the same palette and an unchanged colour count.
expectations: Uses scripts/pixel_scale.py, not a generative upscaler or LANCZOS resize
Output colour count equals input colour count
Keeps the palette block and transparency index

evals.prompt: Run the sprite-forge example pipeline profile in dry-run mode and tell me which stages would spend money.
evals.expected_output: Runs run_pipeline.py pipelines/example.json --dry-run, lists the four stages (anchor, rotate8, walk-clip, walk-2x), identifies anchor, rotate8 and walk-clip as paid stages that stay provider dry-runs without --yes, and notes nothing was generated.
expectations: Names the stages and which are paid
